description:
iscabox is Brazil's sport-fishing assistant. This plugin gives ChatGPT the same catalog our own assistant uses: 1,300+ fishing spots in every Brazilian state (searchable by name, city or proximity), 170 species guides, recommended lures per species, techniques, traced river courses, tide tables with moon phase and solunar windows for 35 ports, and hundreds of reels, rods, lines and lures with today's price on Amazon, Mercado Livre, AliExpress and Shopee.

Ask the way you would ask another angler, in Portuguese: "onde pescar tucunaré no Amazonas?", "que isca usar para traíra em pesqueiro?", "maré em Salvador hoje", "carretilha perfil baixo até R$ 500", "monte uma tralha para robalo com 800 reais".

Every answer comes only from the catalog (no invented prices, models or places) and links to the iscabox page with photo, current price and where to buy. Free, no account needed.

defaultPrompt: Como está a maré em Salvador hoje? Tem horário bom para pescar?
Monte uma tralha completa para robalo com 800 reais
